subject.title: fix(install): bound download_file curl with connect and max-time limits

question: Should the installers add a 10-second curl connection-phase deadline while retaining current main’s 30-second post-connect low-speed policy?
rationale: The new option intentionally changes how long DNS and TLS/proxy setup may take, while current main independently established a 30-second transfer-stall policy; source and curl documentation establish the tradeoff but cannot choose the product tolerance.

options.title: Rebase and preserve 30 seconds
options.body: Keep current main’s post-connect low-speed policy, add `--connect-timeout 10` only if accepted, and attach controlled terminal proof for connection and transfer stalls.

options.title: Adopt a 20-second transfer cutoff
options.body: Explicitly accept the tighter post-connect tolerance and document why a transfer that recovers after 20 but before 30 seconds should now fail.

options.title: Defer the connection deadline
options.body: Keep current main’s post-connect stall protection and close or narrow this PR if a safe connection-phase value is not yet agreed.

recommendation.title: Rebase and preserve 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Keep current main’s post-connect low-speed policy, add `--connect-timeout 10` only if accepted, and attach controlled terminal proof for connection and transfer stalls.
